purpose: Immutable MaterialState envelope for one complete typed Temporal Constraint rule revision.

columns.name: material_state_ref
columns.meaning: Immutable identity of this Temporal Constraint rule revision.
columns.value_contract: Application-issued UUIDv7 represented in material_state_address under facet temporal_constraint.rule.

columns.name: constraint_ref
columns.meaning: Stable Temporal Constraint owner of this rule revision.

columns.name: strength_code
columns.meaning: Whether the rule is hard or soft.

columns.name: constrained_facet_code
columns.meaning: Temporal facet constrained by this B04-A rule.

primary_key.name: pk_temporal_constraint_state
primary_key.reason: One Temporal Constraint rule envelope per immutable MaterialStateRef.

foreign_keys.name: fk_temporal_constraint_state_material_state_address
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind the typed rule envelope to the shared MaterialState address/control space.

foreign_keys.name: fk_temporal_constraint_state_constraint_ref_temporal_constraint
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind every immutable rule revision to one stable Temporal Constraint identity.

unique_constraints.name: uq_temporal_constraint_state_constraint_material
unique_constraints.reason: Provide the exact owner+state key used by current-history and mutation-receipt integrity.

check_constraints.name: ck_temporal_constraint_state_family
check_constraints.reason: B04-A activates only the boundary rule family.

check_constraints.name: ck_temporal_constraint_state_strength
check_constraints.reason: Strength is explicit and bounded; no untyped fallback is accepted.

check_constraints.name: ck_temporal_constraint_state_constrained_facet
check_constraints.reason: B04-A constrains only Schedule start; broader facets belong to later B04 slices.

triggers.name: ctrg_temporal_constraint_state_state_totality
triggers.reason: Require exactly one Temporal Constraint rule envelope for a temporal_constraint.rule MaterialState and exclude cross-family payloads.

triggers.name: ctrg_temporal_constraint_state_rule_totality
triggers.reason: Require the complete typed B04-A boundary payload by transaction end; incomplete canonical rule states are rejected.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Each accepted rule revision is append-only immutable MaterialState truth; old revisions remain reconstructible after current selection moves.
state_history.current_binding: scoped_current_material_state selects at most one accepted current temporal_constraint.rule state per constraint.
state_history.chronology: temporal_constraint_current_history carries currentness episodes; MaterialStateRef order is not chronology.
state_history.immutability_policy: Runtime read access is SELECT-only. Revision still appends a new state and changes currentness through the governed mutation capability.

lifecycle.retention: Retain rule-state history after revise or retire.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE; retirement closes currentness rather than erasing historical rule state.

obligations: one exact temporal_constraint.rule envelope per MaterialStateRef
hard/soft strength and schedule.start facet remain typed and bounded
revision is append-only rather than in-place mutation
cross-family MaterialState payload combinations are rejected
